- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1462-1500 | severity=critical | confidence=5

  WHY: reviewers disagree on whether the `type` guards make the deletion safe, but the majority report a silent loss of fallback extraction when GraphQL returns no linked issues.
- analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md:497 | severity=low | confidence=5

- extracted/poller_stall.sh:1 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: the file starts with `set -euo pipefail` but has no shebang, so direct execution falls back to `/bin/sh` and trips on bashisms.
  WHY: both reviewers noted bash-specific syntax (`[[ ]]`, arrays, `mapfile`, here-strings) in a file intended for standalone execution.
- extracted/poller_stall.sh:67-93 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `workflow_run_cache_load` writes global `WORKFLOW_RUN_CACHE_*` variables without namespace protection.
  WHY: sourcing this file in a shell that already defines the same names can cause collisions; current tests happen to isolate it.
- extracted/poller_stall.sh:1-267 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: the new file is unreferenced dead code and duplicates existing logic.
  WHY: one reviewer found no in-repo consumer and noted it duplicates `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, so it adds maintenance burden without current runtime effect.
